Name: ITEMLOT_PARAM_ST
Description:
Defines item lots that can be rolled upon item pickup, enemy death or granted via script.
When doing this, consecutive IDs are also rolled.
A single result is produced by each row.
A row will not be rolled if the flag is already set.

Fields.Name: Item Acquisition Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag for every slot without its own flag. While it is on, those slots are left out of the roll, so the row gives nothing more. The awarded item carries this flag. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Roll Counter Flag
Fields.Description: First of 8 consecutive event flags holding the row's roll counter as a binary number (this flag is bit 0, so up to 255). Each roll of the row adds 1. 0: no counter.

Fields.Name: Item Accumulate Max
Fields.Description: Counter value at which the slots reach their Item Accumulate Chance. 0: the accumulate weights are not used.

Fields.Name: Item Rarity
Fields.Description: Rarity given to the awarded item instead of its own rarity. Results that share an acquisition flag use the highest. −1: the item's own rarity (Custom Weapons: 0).

Fields.Name: New Game+ Variant
Fields.Description: Uses row ID + value × 100,000,000 instead of this row once the playthrough is high enough: 1 always, 2 from NG+, 3 from NG+2 … 8 from NG+7. The variant's own value continues the chain; give it −1 or a higher value (the same value hangs the game). Only for row IDs whose hundred-million digit is 0.

Fields.Name: Can Friendly Phantom Acquire
Fields.Description: Lets a cooperating phantom roll this row; without it the row is skipped for them.

Fields.Name: Can Hostile Phantom Acquire
Fields.Description: Lets a hostile (invading) phantom roll this row; without it the row is skipped for them.
